two_factor.title: Two-factor login
two_factor.status.on: On: after the password, MakerHub 3D asks for a code from your app.
two_factor.explain: With two-factor login you need a 6-digit code from an app on your phone (e.g. Google Authenticator, Aegis or 2FAS) in addition to your password. Somebody who only knows your password cannot get in.
two_factor.unavailable: Two-factor login cannot be set up yet: the admin has to add a key to the .env file first (see the guide).
two_factor.renew.title: New recovery codes
two_factor.off.title: Turn two-factor login off
two_factor.hint.tfa_password: For safety. Wrong input counts like a failed login.
two_factor.hint.renew_code: Code from the app (or a recovery code). The previous recovery codes stop working. Each code works only once: if you just logged in with it, wait for the next one.
two_factor.hint.off_password: For safety. Wrong input counts like a failed login.
two_factor.hint.off_code: Code from the app (or a recovery code). Each code works only once: if you just logged in with it, wait for the next one.
two_factor.setup.title: Set up two-factor login
two_factor.setup.failed: The code is wrong. Check the time on your phone and enter the current code.
two_factor.setup.step_scan: Open the app on your phone and scan the QR code.
two_factor.setup.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now. Only then is two-factor login switched on.
two_factor.setup.qr_alt: QR code for setting up two-factor login
two_factor.setup.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app instead:
two_factor.codes.title: Your recovery codes
two_factor.codes.saved: Two-factor login is on. New recovery codes are saved.
two_factor.codes.warning: Write these codes down or print them now and keep them safe. They are shown only this once. Each code works exactly once, in case you do not have your phone at hand.
two_factor.key_mismatch: Start stopped: the key in MAKERHUB_2FA_KEY is missing or does not match the stored two-factor setups. Either put the previous key back into the .env file, or - if it is lost - delete the two-factor login of all users with: docker compose run --rm app python -m app.cli reset-2fa (everybody then sets it up again; nothing else is lost).
login_code.title: Enter code
login_code.failed: The code is wrong or was already used.
login_code.hint: 6-digit code from your app - or one of your recovery codes.
cli.usage: Usage: python -m app.cli reset-2fa [username]  (without a name: switches two-factor login off for all users; with a name: only for this user)
cli.reset_2fa.done: Two-factor login deleted. It was on for {count} user(s); everybody can set it up again.
user.two_factor.title: Two-factor login
user.two_factor.self: You switch off your own two-factor login under "My account".
user.two_factor.reset.intro: For example when the phone is lost and no recovery codes are left. The two-factor setup and the recovery codes of this user are deleted, and all of their logins end. Afterwards they log in with the password only and can set up two-factor login again under "My account".
user.two_factor.reset.confirm: Really reset the two-factor login of this user?
user.error.self_2fa: Not reset: you switch off your own two-factor login under "My account".
cli.reset_2fa.user_done: Two-factor login of this user reset. Logging in now needs the password only; it can be set up again under "My account".
cli.reset_2fa.user_was_off: Two-factor login of this user was not switched on. Nothing changed.
cli.reset_2fa.unknown_user: There is no user with this name. Nothing changed.
backup.title: Backups
backup.hint.schedule: The database is backed up every night at 3 am, and automatically before a database change during an update. Kept: the last 14 days, plus the last backup of each month (12 months). Backups before an update: the last 5.
backup.hint.confidential: Confidential: backups contain all data, including password hashes and encrypted two-factor secrets. Store them only in safe places and do not pass them on.
backup.failed: The backup could not be created. See the server log for details.
backup.col.name: File
backup.log_nightly_failed: Nightly backup failed ({reason}). Check the folder and free disk space.
backup.log_pre_migration_failed: Backup before the database change failed ({reason}). The app does not start, to keep the data safe. Check the folder and free disk space.
